text: Agent Rory. Welcome aboard the Narwhal. Sit down. Have some cocoa.
Greenland's glaciers are melting from underneath. In winter. Somebody is drilling for heat.
The drill had a flame on it. Kaldera Heating. 'Keeping the world toasty since 1896'.
It belongs to Baron Magnus Kaldera. He lives inside a volcano. Of course he does.
The drill parts came from a shipyard in Norway. That's where we start.
Find out what the Baron is up to, Agent. And Rory... be careful.
I'm so sorry. I only wanted to build a nice big heater!
The Baron calls them Inferno Engines. Six of them. They drill down and pour volcano heat under the ice.
Under Antarctica?
Yes. Fire all six, and the ice melts in a week. The seas rise sixty metres.
Unless the world pays him one trillion dollars to switch them off.
Then we stop them being built. Well done, Agent Rory. Act One is yours.
Agent Rory. The Baron is building his engines in pieces, all over the world.
Money in Dubai. Guidance in the Atacama Desert. Magma cores from a volcano in Java.
Control chips in Seoul. A test on a glacier in the Himalaya. And ships in Cape Town.
Break enough pieces and the engines won't work. Or at least, not very well.
The Narwhal is at your service. Go.
The engine ships have left Cape Town. They're heading south.
To Antarctica. Six engines, and the Baron with them.
We'll slow him down with every piece you broke, Rory. But it won't be enough.
The Narwhal sails south tonight. Act Two is yours, Agent.
Agent Rory. This is it. The engines are in Antarctica.
The Baron's last supplies come from New Zealand and Argentina. Stop them, then go south.
I'll meet you on the ice. Bring a warm hat.
And I'm bringing the mini-sub! In person! I'm very excited.
Save the ice, Agent. And the penguins.
The engines are off. The ice is freezing again.
And the Baron is sitting in a snowdrift, being told off by a penguin.
I am staying here. Dr Ellie says I can be a penguin keeper.
I made you something, Rory. A gadget. It's a cup of cocoa. It's just cocoa.
Agent Rory. For saving the ice at the bottom of the world, POLARIS awards you the Order of the Narwhal.
Well done, Agent. Mission complete.
The rig is out past the floes. The ice keeps breaking into pieces and drifting.
Hop from floe to floe. Tap or swipe to jump, and ride them, but don't ride off the edge!
Made it across. And the water under the floes is warm!
This research hut froze solid overnight. The floor is pure ice.
You'll slide until something stops you. Use the rocks to steer and slide out through the gap.
Found the scientist's notebook. The last page just says: THE HEAT IS COMING FROM BELOW.
I've built a drone the size of a sandwich. Let's fly it into that rig through the air vents.
Hold the screen to fly up, let go to drop. Squeeze through the gaps!
Look at the camera. A giant drill, glowing orange, boring straight down through the ice.
And there's a logo on it. A flame in a circle.
I saw the man who drove the rig's snowcat away. I'll tell you what I remember.
Build his face from Nuka's clues, then show it to Nuka.
That's him! Big as a bear. And he had a penguin sticking out of his coat.
Uh oh. The drill's going deeper. The whole fjord is starting to crack!
Take the POLARIS snowmobile. Go, go, go!
Drag to steer. BOOST when the crack gets close!
Phew! Made it off the ice just in time.
Admiral Frost is sending the Narwhal to pick you up. You'll want to see this, Rory.
The shipyard's quay is covered in security cameras. They turn and turn.
Flick paint pellets at them. The pellets take time to fly, so aim ahead of the camera!
All painted. They can't see a thing.
The gatehouse panel controls the lights. Every switch flips itself and its neighbours.
Turn every light off and the gatehouse goes dark. Then we slip in.
Lights out! Olaf, stop squawking, you'll give us away!
The big crane is loading crates onto the tender. Some have the flame on them.
Drop the claw on the flame crates only. Leave our POLARIS supplies alone.
Got them. They're full of drill parts. Still warm!
Your spy car is stuck in the lorry yard. The lorries are blocking the gate.
Slide the lorries and cars along their lanes. Get the orange car out!
I'm out! And every lorry here is heading for the tender.
The tender's casting off! She's heading down the fjord!
Catch it in Lars's speedboat. BOOST to catch up, then TAG it with a tracking dart!
Tagged! And look what fell out of the wheelhouse: an invitation with gold letters.
The Baron is on the casino floor, talking to his guests. We need to get close.
Hold to sneak forward. When the guard turns round, let go and freeze like a waiter!
I heard him. He said: 'Soon the whole world will pay me to switch it off.'
One of the Baron's henchmen is on the terrace in disguise. He has the Baron's plans.
Read the clues and tap the henchman. Don't tap the tourists!
Got him. And his briefcase has two words on it: PROJECT MELTDOWN.
The Baron's yacht has a computer in the office. We need to power it up without anyone noticing.
Join each pair of sockets with a cable. Cables can't cross, and every square must be filled.
It's on! A map of the world with six red dots... and one of them is at the South Pole.
Uh oh. The henchmen know you're here. They're on the ballroom balconies!
Tag the henchmen in red with paint before they raise the alarm. Not the guests!
That's all of them. Now where's Scorch?
Scorch is in the pit lane! She's taking the Baron's race car round the circuit!
Catch her in the POLARIS car. Close the gap, then TAG!
Tagged! But she got away. She dropped this: a train ticket to Barcelona.
Scorch's van is stuck in the narrow streets. So is our car!
Slide the cars out of the way and get the spy car through.
Through! The van went into the park.
The park has cameras hidden in the mosaics. Kaldera's cameras.
Paint them. Aim where they're going to be, not where they are!
Now nobody can see us. This way!
Scorch ran into the market hall. The fish floor is solid ice!
You'll slide until something stops you. Use the crates. Slide out through the gap!
Out! And she dropped something: the blueprint tube is empty. She's got them on her.
She's on the rooftops! I can't follow her up there.
My drone can. Fly it between the chimneys. Hold to go up, let go to drop.
Got her on camera. She's heading down to her motorbike!
Take my motorbike! Catch her!
Get close and TAG her. If she drops the blueprints, grab them!
Tagged! She dropped half the blueprints. INFERNO ENGINE... Test drill: Santorini.
My papa saw the man who borrowed his boat. Can you draw him?
Build the face from Papa's clues, then show him.
That's him! Papa says he kept saying sorry to the boat.
The barge's crane is pulling samples out of the volcano. We need one.
Drop the claw on the crates with the flame. The belt moves, so drop it early!
Got one. It's a rock. And it's glowing.
The drill's control hut is on the cliff. Every switch flips its neighbours.
Switch off all the heaters and the drill stops.
Switched off! But I think we were too late. Listen...
The nervous man is running away down the white steps! He's in a disguise!
Read the clues. Find him in the crowd.
Found him! Oh no, he's jumped on a donkey. It's surprisingly fast.
The drill's blown! A giant wave is coming across the lagoon!
Take my jet ski! Outrun it!
Whoa! That was the biggest wave I've ever seen.
Dr Cinder got away on the ferry. He's booked on a train in Canada.
Dr Cinder is hiding in the dining car. There's a guard watching the door.
Move while the guard looks away. Freeze when he turns. You're just a waiter with pancakes.
Found his seat. He left a napkin covered in sums. Six of something. Times one trillion.
The baggage car radio is broken. Fix it and we can call POLARIS.
Join each pair of sockets. No crossing, and fill every square!
Frost here. Good work, Agent. The Narwhal is racing north to meet the train.
Henchmen! They're popping out of the sleeper carriage windows!
Tag the ones in red. Not the passengers in pyjamas!
That's the last one. Dr Cinder's cabin is empty, though.
Cinder's floating down the river on a log! Follow him!
Hop across the logs. Don't fall in, it's freezing!
Caught up with him on the bank. He's out of breath. And he's saying sorry again.
There's Scorch, skiing off down the mountain!
On your skis, Rory! Catch her and TAG her!
Tagged her! She's stuck in a snowdrift. Just her helmet showing.
Dr Cinder wants to talk. And he says it's worse than we think.
The Baron's meeting is on the helipad. We'll drop in from above.
Steer your parachute onto the pad. Watch the wind!
Landed! He was talking about a desert. And a telescope.
The Baron's bank office is on the fortieth floor. My window-cleaning cable goes right past it.
Keep your balance. Push against the wind!
I can see inside. Stacks of gold. And a sign: 'For the guidance systems'.
The vault lock is made of switches and gates. AND needs both on. OR needs one. NOT flips it.
Set the switches so the lamp lights.
Open! Account books. Every payment goes to... Atacama, Chile.
We need to smuggle the account books out through the souk.
Fit every gadget into the case. Tap one to turn it.
Packed! Nobody will look twice at a boy with a suitcase.
The courier's driving the gold out on the desert highway!
Catch him in the supercar. BOOST, then TAG!
Tagged! The gold's going back to the bank.
But the parts are already made. Next stop: the Atacama Desert.
The Baron's ore carts are carrying the guidance parts out of the mine.
Tap the junctions to send each train to the platform of its colour.
Every cart's in the wrong place. That'll slow them down!
My telescope's gearbox has been sabotaged. It can't turn.
Add gears so the motor turns the telescope the right way. Three in a triangle will jam!
It's turning! And look. That orange satellite is the Baron's.
The cold lab's coolant is all mixed up. The guidance chips need exactly the right amount.
Pour between the tanks to measure it exactly.
Cooled. The chips say: 'Target: Antarctica'.
The Baron's helicopter is coming to collect the chips. Land first and we'll swap them!
Hold LIFT to go up. Land gently on the pad.
Swapped! His chips will now steer his engines to... a very nice beach.
His trucks are coming over the dunes!
Escape in the buggy! Don't let them catch you!
Lost them in the dunes.
The trucks were heading for a ship. Its next stop is Java. Mount Bromo.
The geothermal plant's pipes have been twisted round to feed the Baron's machines.
Turn the pipes so the coolant runs from the tank to the engine.
The plant's back to normal. And the Baron's machines are getting cold.
The crater warehouse is full of the Baron's crates. They're on the wrong squares.
Push every crate onto a marked square. You can push, but you can't pull!
All in place. And behind the crates: a magma core, glowing.
The magma core is overheating. If it blows, the whole crater goes with it!
Tap a valve to cool its gauge. Keep every needle out of the red!
Phew. You saved the mountain, Agent Rory.
The Baron's henchmen are at the festival. Dance and they won't notice you!
Tap the pads in time as the arrows reach the line.
They were talking while they danced. The cores are going to Seoul.
Scorch is flying off with a magma core!
Put on the wingsuit and catch her. Fly through the rings for a boost!
Tagged! She dropped the core into the sea. Sizzle.
Next stop Seoul. Pack your dancing shoes.
The Baron's deal happens during the concert. Dance and nobody will notice you!
Tap the pads in time. Fill the BLEND IN meter!
Great dancing. And the Baron's courier has the chips in a guitar case.
The chip factory door has a lock made of logic gates.
Set the switches so the lamps light.
We're in! I told you I love gates.
In the clean room, we'll swap the Baron's chips for our fakes.
Pack every piece into the case. Tap to turn them.
Swapped. His engines will now play K-pop instead of drilling.
The courier's meeting Scorch at the bottom of the TV tower. Skydive down!
Steer onto the pad. Watch the wind round the tower!
Landed! The courier's getting on a motorbike.
Take my bike! Follow the neon!
Catch the courier. BOOST and TAG!
Tagged! The guitar case is ours.
But the engines are almost done. The last test is on a glacier in Nepal.
The only way to the test site is over the rope bridge.
Across! I can hear the engine humming from here.
Pip's helicopter is bringing climbing gear. The pad is tiny!
Hold LIFT and steer gently onto the pad.
Landed! Not bad for a ten-year-old pilot.
The Baron's boxes are hidden in the monastery storeroom.
Push them onto the marked squares so the monks can have their room back.
Tidy! And the boxes are full of maps of Antarctica.
The test engine is overheating. The glacier will melt!
Vent the gauges before they go red!
It's cooling. The ice has stopped weeping.
The engine's shaken the snow loose. Avalanche!
Snowboard down the mountain! Don't let it catch you!
Outran an avalanche. Can I do that again?
No! The engines are being loaded onto ships in Cape Town. Go!
The engine wagons are in the harbour sidings, waiting for the ship.
Switch the points so every train goes to the platform of its colour.
Mixed up! Half the Baron's wagons are going to the fish market.
The engine ship's coolant pipes are wrong. If we fix them, the engines can't heat up on the voyage.
Turn the pipes to join the tank to the engine.
Fixed. The engines will arrive cold and cross.
The Baron is watching from the cable car. Its gearbox is jammed!
Place the gears so the cable car turns the right way.
Moving! From up here I can see the big man. He's feeding Captain Wobble.
The ship's fuel tanks need exactly the right mix, or the Baron will notice.
Measure it exactly!
Perfect. The ship will run out of fuel just before Antarctica.
The ship's leaving! Take the speedboat!
Catch it and TAG it with a tracker!
Tagged. We can follow it anywhere.
And it's going exactly where we thought. Antarctica.
The Baron has rewired our geothermal station to feed his ships.
Turn the pipes to send the heat back to the village.
Our pools are warm again. Thank you!
His machines are on the far side of the boiling pools.
Hop across on the stepping rafts. Don't fall in, it's boiling!
Across! His machines are packing up. He's leaving.
Scorch is hiding in the village in disguise!
Read the clues. Find her!
Found her! Oh no, she's heading for the river.
We'll follow her from the air. Land by the river!
Hold LIFT and land gently on the pad.
Down! There she is, in a jet boat.
Take the jet boat through the canyon!
Catch her! BOOST and TAG!
Tagged! She's heading south. Everyone's heading south.
The Baron's boxes are on the End of the World Train.
Switch the points. Send every train to its own colour.
Sent! The boxes are going to the museum.
Our icebreaker's jeep is stuck in the container port.
Slide the lorries out of the way!
Free! And look, those lorries are Kaldera's.
The Baron's henchmen are trying to take over the icebreaker!
Tag the henchmen. Not the crew!
The icebreaker's ours. It'll carry you south.
You'll need polar kit for Antarctica.
Pack everything into the case. Tap to turn.
Packed. Snow goggles, cocoa, and a spare penguin costume. Just in case.
The convoy's racing us to the port!
Get there first in the jeep! Don't let them catch you!
Made it! The icebreaker's waiting.
The big man is hiding in the penguin colony. Let's sneak up on him.
Put on the penguin costume. Move when he looks away, freeze when he turns!
Got close. He's talking to the penguins. He's telling them he's sorry.
Someone used our station radio last night. I saw them from the window.
Build the face from Ellie's clues.
That's Scorch! She radioed the Baron: 'The engines start in two days'.
Bruno has run off across the crevasse!
Cross on the ladder. Keep your balance!
Across. He's waiting for me. He's holding a penguin.
The station generator's overheating. If it goes, the station freezes.
Keep the gauges out of the red!
Saved! My penguins thank you.
Scorch is escaping to the ice shelf!
Catch her on the snowmobile!
Tagged! She's stuck in a snowbank. Again.
Small spy. I will tell you everything. The engines are on the Ross Ice Shelf.
Inferno Engine One. Its gearbox is right there.
Add gears so the brake turns the right way. That jams the drill!
Engine One is jammed. Five to go.
The relay mast links all six engines.
Rewire it. Join each pair, fill every square.
The engines can't talk to each other any more.
The sentry drones are watching the depot.
Paint them! Aim ahead!
Blind drones. Clear to the depot.
The fuel drums need moving so the engines run dry.
Push them onto the marked squares!
Done. The engines are running out of fuel.
The Baron's switched the engines to full power. The shelf's cracking!
Get to the hovercraft! Escape!
That was close. The engines are dying, but the Baron's gone.
His submarine was seen heading for the ice caves.
The ice tunnel goes deep. Let's send the drone first.
Hold to go up, let go to drop. Mind the icicles!
The tunnel leads to the dock.
The cavern floor is smooth ice. Slide carefully!
Slide out through the gap.
Inside the ice... spare engine parts. Frozen solid.
The dock's lock uses logic gates.
Light the lamps!
Open. The Baron's submarine is right there.
My mini-sub needs exactly the right amount of ballast water.
Perfect. We can dive.
The Baron's sub is escaping through the moon pool!
Catch it! BOOST and TAG!
Tagged! It's heading for Mount Erebus.
The way in is from above. Jump into the crater!
Steer onto the rim. Watch the hot wind!
Landed on the rim. I can see the lava lake.
The Baron's party is in the great hall. Dance!
Tap in time. Blend in!
He's making a speech. 'Tomorrow, the world pays me a trillion dollars!'
The master keys hang over the lava pit.
Drop the claw on the flame crate. Carefully!
Got the keys. And they're only a bit melted.
The master control room. Every switch flips its neighbours.
Switch off all six engines!
No! My beautiful engines! Who switched them off?
POLARIS did. Your ice is safe, Baron.
You will never catch me! I have a gold bobsled!
Take mine! It is faster. It has penguin stickers.
Catch the Baron, Rory! One last TAG!
Curses! Stuck in a snowdrift. How undignified.
Baron Kaldera, you're coming with us.
Agent Rory, can you hear me? It's Pip. Welcome to Greenland, the coldest job you've ever had.
Something is melting the glaciers here from underneath. In the middle of winter! That's impossible.
You're the spy? I'm Nuka. My dogs found the problem. Follow me, and mind the thin ice.
That rig had a logo on its side. A flame in a circle: Kaldera Heating.
And the drill was made in a shipyard in Norway. Admiral Frost wants to see you. Now.
Ahoy, young spy! Captain Lars. Forty years I've sailed this fjord. And this is my parrot, Olaf.
That shipyard started building strange things last spring. Orange things. Hot things. Olaf doesn't like it.
Rory, the tender was carrying an invitation. Gold letters. Very fancy.
Baron Kaldera's Winter Gala. In Monte Carlo. Tomorrow night. I'll find you a bow tie!
Psst! Agent Rory? I'm Luca. I fix racing cars. The Baron's party is at the casino tonight.
Everyone important is here. And so is Scorch, his stunt rider. She never takes her helmet off.
Scorch dropped a ticket when you tagged her. Barcelona, first train in the morning.
And Rory... I heard the words on the yacht. Project Meltdown. I don't like the sound of that.
Hola! I'm Inés. I know every rooftop in Barcelona. Skateboard's faster than a taxi.
A rider in a flame helmet rode in this morning. She went into the old town with a long tube. Blueprints, I bet.
We got half the blueprints back. Look at the title: INFERNO ENGINE.
And a note at the bottom: 'Test drill: Santorini'. That's a volcano, Rory.
Yassou! I'm Nikos. My papa is a fisherman. Somebody borrowed his boat last night and brought it back all sooty!
And look down there in the volcano's lagoon. A drill barge. It's been bubbling all morning.
The nervous man is called Dr Cinder. He designed the Inferno Engine.
And he's just bought a ticket on a train through the Canadian Rockies. We're going to Canada!
Welcome to Banff, Agent Rory! I'm Ranger Mac. And this is Gerald. He's a moose.
The Rocky Mountain train leaves today. A nervous man got on it with far too many suitcases.
Rory. Frost here. We have Dr Cinder aboard the Narwhal. He's been talking.
Come home, Agent. You need to hear this yourself.
Marhaba, Agent Rory! I'm Omar. I clean the windows on the tallest tower in the world. I see everything.
Every day a man in an orange tie goes into the bank. Every day he comes out with gold.
The Baron's gold is paying for the engines' guidance systems. They're being made in the Atacama Desert, in Chile.
And Rory, they steer by the stars.
Welcome to the Atacama, the driest desert on Earth. I'm Dr Valentina. I watch the stars.
Somebody has been borrowing my telescope at night. And my cold lab smells of burnt toast.
The guidance chips are programmed to steer the engines to the South Pole.
But they need magma cores to heat up. Those are coming from a volcano in Indonesia.
Selamat pagi, Agent Rory! I'm Budi, a volcano guide. Welcome to Mount Bromo at sunrise.
The Baron has built a warehouse inside the crater. His machines are scooping out the volcano's heat.
The magma cores are going to Seoul, to be joined to control chips.
And Rory, Scorch said something about 'the boss's concert'.
Annyeong! I'm Min-jun. I'm eleven, and I can hack anything. Mostly.
The Baron's chip factory makes control chips. Tonight he's collecting them at a concert. A K-pop concert!
The chips and the cores are being joined into six Inferno Engines.
The last test is on a glacier in the Himalaya. In Nepal.
Namaste, Agent Rory. I'm Tenzing. My family have guided climbers here for a hundred years.
Three weeks ago, a machine started drilling into our glacier. The ice is weeping.
The test is finished. The engines are ready, Rory.
Six ships are loading them in Cape Town. Next stop, South Africa.
Sawubona, Agent Rory! I'm Thandi. I look after the penguins at Boulders Beach.
Something strange: a huge man keeps coming to feed my penguins sardines. He cries a little when he leaves.
Rory, the engine ships are heading south. To Antarctica.
Come home. The Narwhal sails south tonight.
Kia ora, Agent Rory! I'm Aroha, a geothermal guide. Welcome to Rotorua.
The Baron is taking our hot springs' heat for his engines. Our pools are going cold.
The Baron's last supply ship leaves from Ushuaia, in Argentina. The last port before the ice.
After that, Rory, it's Antarctica.
Hola! I'm Lucía, deckhand on the icebreaker. This is Ushuaia, the end of the world.
The Baron's convoy arrived this morning. Tomorrow they sail for Antarctica.
Rory, this is it. Antarctica.
The Narwhal will surface at the Peninsula. Wrap up warm, Agent.
Hello, hello! Dr Ellie. I count penguins. It's the best job in the world.
Something's wrong. The ice is getting soft, and there's a very big man hiding in my penguin colony.
Small spy. I am Bruno. I work for the Baron. But the Baron's engines will cook the penguins.
I don't want that. I will help you. The engines are on the Ross Ice Shelf.
Rory! Zara, in person. Good to see you out of the phone.
That tower's Inferno Engine One. Five more are further out. If they fire, the ice melts in a week.
The engines are jammed, but the Baron has a submarine hidden in the ice caves.
I'm coming with you, Rory. In person. I've got a mini-sub!
Rory! It's me, Pip! In real life! Look, I brought the mini-sub.
The Baron's submarine is docked in these caves. And it's full of spare engine parts.
The Baron's sub is heading for Mount Erebus. The real volcano at the bottom of the world.
That's his lair, Rory. That's where it ends.
Small spy. Welcome to the Baron's lair. I know every room.
He is having a party. He thinks he has won. He has not.
You did it, Rory.
The ice has been groaning at night. My dogs won't sleep.
Floes don't drift like that in winter. Something is warming the water.
That rig wasn't there last month. Nobody built it. It just appeared.
The big man drove off on a snowcat. He was humming. To a penguin.
Go! Before the whole fjord cracks!
You want the drifting floes. It is the one that glows.
Look for the drifting floes, marked with a floating sign.
The drifting floes. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the frozen research hut. It is the one that glows.
Look for the frozen research hut, marked with a floating sign.
The frozen research hut. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the drilling rig. It is the one that glows.
Look for the drilling rig, marked with a floating sign.
The drilling rig. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want Nuka's dog sled. It is the one that glows.
Look for Nuka's dog sled, marked with a floating sign.
Nuka's dog sled. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the POLARIS snowmobile. It is the one that glows.
Look for the POLARIS snowmobile, marked with a floating sign.
The POLARIS snowmobile. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
That is everything here. Your plane is waiting, Agent Rory.
Nothing else for you in this city. Off you go.
We are done here. Safe flight, Agent Rory.
Intel won. The sea under the ice is as warm as a bath. Something down there is heating it.
Intel won. Before she left, the scientist wrote that the heat is coming from deep below the ice.
Intel won. A glowing drill is boring down through the ice. It is stamped with a flame logo: Kaldera Heating.
Intel won. The rig's driver is enormous, wears a woolly hat, and carries a penguin in his coat.
Intel won. The drill's parts were built in a shipyard in Geiranger, Norway.
Olaf says hello. Well, Olaf says 'SQUAWK', but it means hello.
Cameras everywhere on that quay. Paint them, I say!
Those crates were too hot to touch. My gloves melted.
The lorries are all going the same way. Towards the tender.
The tender's getting away! My speedboat's yours!
You want the shipyard quay. It is the one that glows.
Look for the shipyard quay, marked with a floating sign.
The shipyard quay. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the gatehouse panel. It is the one that glows.
Look for the gatehouse panel, marked with a floating sign.
The gatehouse panel. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the dockside crane. It is the one that glows.
Look for the dockside crane, marked with a floating sign.
The dockside crane. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the lorry yard. It is the one that glows.
Look for the lorry yard, marked with a floating sign.
The lorry yard. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want Lars's speedboat. It is the one that glows.
Look for Lars's speedboat, marked with a floating sign.
Lars's speedboat. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
That is everything here. Your plane is waiting, Agent Rory.
Nothing else for you in this city. Off you go.
We are done here. Safe flight, Agent Rory.
Intel won. Kaldera's cameras are blinded with POLARIS paint. Nobody saw Rory arrive.
Intel won. The gatehouse is dark. The shipyard gate is open.
Intel won. The crates are full of drill parts, made here and shipped out on the rig's tender.
Intel won. Every lorry in the yard is taking Kaldera's parts to the tender.
Intel won. Baron Kaldera is holding a Winter Gala at the casino in Monte Carlo.
Nice bow tie! You look like a very small waiter.
The Baron's guards watch the casino floor. Freeze when they turn!
The Baron's yacht is parked in the harbour. Black and orange. Very loud.
Scorch drives like she's on fire. She probably is.
Get in the car! The pit lane is open!
You want the casino floor. It is the one that glows.
Look for the casino floor, marked with a floating sign.
The casino floor. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the casino terrace. It is the one that glows.
Look for the casino terrace, marked with a floating sign.
The casino terrace. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the Baron's yacht. It is the one that glows.
Look for the Baron's yacht, marked with a floating sign.
The Baron's yacht. Follow the glow and you cannot miss it.
You want the ballroom balconies. It is the one that glows.
Look for the ballroom balconies, marked with a floating sign.
